from object_detector import Object_Detector_Tool
from text_detector import Text_Detector_Tool

# Assuming the JSON path to the scene image file is /nfs/data8/liao/wxie/SAT/SAT_images_train/6252_0.png
scene_image_path = "/nfs/data8/liao/wxie/SAT/SAT_images_train/6252_0.png"

image_data = {"path": scene_image_path}

object_labels = ["bed", "shelf", "painting"]
threshold = 0.35
save_object = False
saved_image_path = "detected_objects"

# Detect objects
object_results = Object_Detector_Tool.execute(image=image_data, labels=object_labels, save_object=True, saved_image_path=saved_image_path, threshold=threshold, model_size="tiny")

# Detect text
text_results = Text_Detector_Tool.execute(image=image_data, languages=["en"])

# Combine and display the results
final_result = [["1", "0", 1], *[{"label": result[1], "confidence_score": result[2]} for result in object_results], *[{"label": result[1], "found": 1 if result[1] not in text_results[False] else 0} for result in object_results], *[{"labels": result[1], "found": len(text_results[True])} for result in object_results], [["", "English"]]]

print("Final result: \n", final_result)
